finding.diagnosis: The browser test reloaded the public page with waitUntil=domcontentloaded, then immediately counted an element rendered only after the asynchronous /api/public/pages fetch. The production renderer starts loadPage() from the page script and awaits that request; DOMContentLoaded does not guarantee the public Page Model is rendered. This is test synchronization, not evidence of a deployed runtime failure.

change.behavior: After the Save reload the browser waits for the already-published baseline divider before asserting that draft-only nodes are absent. After explicit Publish and reload it waits for the newly published divider before asserting all eight new palette nodes and their visual styles.
